notes: Version 1.0.222 — fixes a NAS/reparse-point crash in the HEX/Text scanner ("Skaner").
changelog: Fixed: running the HEX/Text scanner against a network (NAS) task could throw a blocking "could not open the file" error on certain reparse-point-heavy folders and stop the scan. The scanner now uses the same tolerant native file-walking already used elsewhere in the app, so it skips past problem entries instead of aborting.
